I'm contesting the charges with PayPal since the terms say 30 day money back guarantee but the company refuses to contact me. I will then delete my account.

reviews.title: False “Free” + Fabricated Reviews
reviews.text: The reviews on this app are clearly fabricated. As soon as you open this application you are hit with a paywall. If you click out of the paywall and try to interact with the adblocker (the entire function of the application) you get hit with another paywall. I don’t understand the appeal of putting something on the AppStore for free if it costs money to even start using.
